newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin ends up four cents on steady LME,adjustment.
newsitem.headline: KL tin ends up four cents on steady LME,adjustment.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price closed up four cents at 14.27 ringgit ($5.73) a kg, reversing recent downtrend on technical adjustment and a steady London Metal Exchange (LME) close overnight, traders said.

"The market needs to adjust after the sharp fall. There's also some pre-holiday covering," said one trader. The market is closed from February 6 to 11 for the Chinese New Year and Eid al-Fitr holidays.
Turnover was 128 tonnes, against 126 on Monday, and was again absorbed by European, Japanese and local interests.
Traders said they expected further recovery in the local price, barring any sharp drop in London.
The local price premium over LME narrowed further to $20 a tonne against $35 previously.
